title: biggest crowds 2025–26.
question: Which Premier League club drew the biggest home crowds last season?

items.name: Tottenham Hotspur
items.fact: Won only 10 of their 38 league games all season.

items.name: Arsenal
items.fact: Crowned champions, ending a 22-year wait for the title.

items.name: Liverpool
items.fact: The defending champions grabbed the last Champions League spot on the final day.

items.name: West Ham United
items.fact: Relegated to the Championship despite these huge crowds.

items.name: Manchester United
items.fact: Finished third, and Bruno Fernandes was named the season's best player.

ending: West Ham drew the league's second-biggest crowds and still went down.
